title: 18.75-Inch Oval Combination Shower Basket, Wall Mount Solid Brass Bathroom Caddy, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep shower essentials organized and off the floor with an elegant, space-saving basket that looks at home in a traditional bathroom. Choose from 28 designer finishes to match any decor.

  • Get a cleaner shower with wall-mount storage that frees up ledges and corners
  • Enjoy faster drying with ventilated, heavy-gauge wires designed for wet areas
  • Maintain a refined look with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Count on lasting durability—solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives

Specs

  • Product type: Oval combination shower basket
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 x 2.25 x 4.13 in
  • Projection: 4.13 in
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Product weight: 4.8 lb
  • Includes: Basket and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces to coordinate your classic bath accessories.
